content: KAUN-O mahseniong soukohp Sehu, nein Ananai, oh ketikihong mahsen pwukat ong Paasa:
“Kowe sohte mehkot, I ahpw wiahkinuhkala kaunen nei aramas akan en Israel. Oh met ke dipadahr duwehte Seropoham oh kahrehiongehr nei aramas en Israel nan dihp. Diparail kan kahredahr ei engieng,
eri, I pahn kasohrehla kowe oh omw peneinei, duwehte me I wiahiong Seropoham.
Kidi kan pahn kangala kisehn omw peneinei men me pahn mehla nan kahnimwo, oh menpihr kan pahn kangala mehmen me pahn mehla nansapw.”
Mehkoaros me Paasa wiadahr oh eh doadoahk kommwad koaros ntinting nan Pwuhken Poadopoad en Nanmwarki kan en Israel.
Paasa sipalla oh seridi nan Tirsa, oh sapwellime pwutak Elah me uhd wiliandi oh wiahla nanmwarki.

Soukohp Sehu kohpadahr mahseno me sang rehn KAUN-O me uhwong Paasa oh eh peneinei, pwehki dihp me Paasa wiahiongehr KAUN-O. E kahngiangihada KAUN-O, kaidehk wiewia suwed kante me e wiahda, duwehte me Nanmwarki Seropoham wiadahr mwowe, ahpw pil pwehki eh kemehla en Seropoham peneinei koaros.
Elah Nanmwarkien Israel
Ni kaeisek weneun sounpar en mwehin Asa, nanmwarkien Suda, Elah nein Paasa wiahla nanmwarkien Israel, oh e kakaunki Tirsa erein sounpar riau.

Simri, emen sapwellime lapalap ako, me kin apwahpwalih ekei tehnweren nanmwarki werenansapw ako, ahpw wiahda koasoandien uhwong nanmwarkio. Rahn ehu nan Tirsa, Elah ahpw sakaula ni imwen Arsa, iei ih me kin apwahpwalih tehnpaso.
Simri eri pedolong nan ihmwo, oh kemehla Elah, e ahpw uhd wiliandi wiahla nanmwarki. Met wiawiher ni karieisek isuhn mwehin Asa, nanmwarkien Suda.
Ni ahnsou me Simri wiahla nanmwarki, e ahpw mwadangete kemehla kisehn en Paasa eh peneinei koaros. Kiseh ohl oh kompoakepah koaros kamakamala.
Eri, e ahpw pweida me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong soukohp Sehu pwehn padahkihong Paasa, Simri kemehla en Paasa peneinei koaros.
Pwehki ar kin pwongih dikedik en eni oh pwehki ar kahrehiong Israel nan dihp, Paasa oh sapwellime pwutak Elah kahredahr engieng en KAUN-O, Koht en Israel.
Mehkoaros me Elah wiadahr ntinting nan Pwuhken Poadopoad en Nanmwarki kan en Israel.
Simri Nanmwarkien Israel
Ni kerieisek isuhn sounpar en mwehin Asa, nanmwarkien Suda, Simri kakaunki Tirsa nan Israel erein rahn isuh. Sounpein Israel wie mahmahweniong kahnimw Kippedon nan Pilisdia,
oh ni ar rongada me Simri wiadahr koasoandien uhwong nanmwarki oh kemelahr, re ahpw wiahda wasao arail kalohk me arail kaun lapalap en sounpei, Omri, wialahr nanmwarkien Israel.
Omri oh nah sounpei ko mweselsang Kippedon oh kolahng mahweniong Tirsa.
Ni Simri eh mahsanihada me kahnimwo ohlahr, e ketilong nan kelen tehnpaso, isikada tehnpaso, e ahpw sipalla nan kisinieio.
Met wiawiher pwehki dihp kan me e wiahiong KAUN-O. Duwehte nanmwarkien mwowe, Seropoham, e kahngiangihkihda KAUN-O dipe kan oh pil kahrehiong mehn Israel nan dihp.
Mehkoaros me Simri wiadahr ntinting nan Pwuhken Poadopoad en Nanmwarki kan en Israel.
Omri Nanmwarkien Israel
Mehn Israel kan pwalpeseng: ekei irail mwahuki Tipni, nein Kinad en wiahla nanmwarki, a ekei mwahuki Omri.
Ni imwilah, irail kan me mwahuki Omri ahpw pweida; Tipni mehla oh Omri wiahla nanmwarki.
Eri, ni kasilihsek ehun sounpar en mwehin Asa, nanmwarkien Suda, Omri wiahla nanmwarkien Israel, oh e kakaunki erein sounpar eisek riau. Ni tepin keweneun sounpar e kakaun nan Tirsa,

mwuhr e ahpw uhd pwainda dohl en Sameria, e pwainkihda mwohni silper wenekid sang rehn ohl emen ede Semer. Omri eri kelehdi dohlo, kauwada kahnimw ehu wasao, oh kihong ede Sameria, eden Semer, me sapweniki dohlo mahs.
Omri dipada ong KAUN-O laudsang dipen nanmwarkien mwowe kan.
Duwehte nanmwarkien mwowe Seropoham, e kahngiangihada KAUN-O, Koht en Israel, ni eh wiahda dihp oh pil kahrehiong mehn Israel nan dihp oh kahrehiong irail en pwongih dikedik en eni.
Mehkoaros me Omri wiadahr ntinting nan Pwuhken Poadopoad en Nanmwarki kan en Israel.
Omri sipalla oh seridi Sameria, oh nah pwutak Eihap me uhd wiliandi wiahla nanmwarki.
Eihap Nanmwarkien Israel
Ni kasilihsek waluhn sounpar en mwehin Asa, nanmwarkien Suda, Eihap nein Omri wiahla nanmwarkien Israel oh e kakaunki nan Sameria erein sounpar rieisek riau.
E wiahda dihp ong KAUN-O laudsang nanmwarkien mwowe kan.
E sohte itarki eh wiahda dihp me duwehte en Nanmwarki Seropoham; e ahpw pil kalaudehla oh pwoudikihda Sesepel, sapwellimen Saidon, nanmwarkien Edpaal serepein, oh pil pwongih Paal.
E kauwada tehnpas ehu ong Paal nan Sameria, wiahda pei sarawi ehu, oh kihlong nan tehnpaso.
E pil wiahda sansal en koht lih Asera. E kahngiangihada mehlel KAUN-O laudsang nanmwarki koaros en mwowe kan.

Nan eh mwehi Iel mehn Pedel kauwada sapahl Seriko. Nin duwen me Sosua nein Nun, kohpadahr sang rehn KAUN-O. Nein Iel pwutak, Apiram mehla ni ahnsou me e wiahda poahsoan en Seriko, oh nah pwutak tikitiko mehla ni ahnsou me e kauwada kehlo.
